mapper.insert: INSERT INTO location_records (lat, lng, latitude, longitude, bearing, device_id, raw_data, payload_json, record_type, create_time, recorded_at) VALUES (#{lat}, #{lng}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{bearing}, #{deviceId}, #{rawData}, #{payloadJson}, #{recordType}, NOW(), #{recordedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM location_records ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM location_records WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND record_type = 'LOCATION' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM location_records WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND record_type = #{type} ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
